title: Where the name Lancaster came from
text: Nobody is sure where Lancaster got its name. It has been attributed to the surname of a railroad station clerk, to a nickname given by railroad officials, or to Lancaster, Pennsylvania, the former home of unknown settlers. The settlement began with the Southern Pacific Railroad, which completed its line through the Antelope Valley in 1876, linking San Francisco and Los Angeles.
